title: gardenia buffalina
intro: Gardenia buffalina, commonly known as Qishu, is a type of flowering plant native to China. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and acting as an antioxidant. The health benefits of Gardenia buffalina include anti-inflammatory and antiviral properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Gardenia buffalina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of soothing the throat, reducing cough, and promoting relaxation.
